entries.wording: 会员后台运单创建成功
entries.english: Waybill created in the customer's account
entries.note: The first row, written when the customer books the parcel.

entries.wording: 纽约1号仓已入库，待打包
entries.english: Taken into New York warehouse 1, waiting to be packed

entries.wording: 纽约1号仓已揽收
entries.english: Collected at New York warehouse 1

entries.wording: 纽约1号仓已审核
entries.english: Checked at New York warehouse 1

entries.wording: 纽约1号仓已扣款
entries.english: Charged at New York warehouse 1

entries.wording: 出库中
entries.english: Leaving the warehouse

entries.wording: 美国纽约州纽约市顺达出库中 已扫描
entries.english: Scanned leaving SD Group's warehouse in New York

entries.wording: 【美国 - 纽约】包裹已到达【纽约顺达转运仓】
entries.english: The parcel has reached <warehouse>
entries.note: The line-haul feed's first row, at the forwarding warehouse.

entries.wording: 【包裹已入库，正在操作，等待出库】
entries.english: The parcel is in the warehouse, being processed and waiting to leave

entries.wording: 【美国 - 纽约】包裹已从【纽约顺达转运仓】出库，等待干线运输
entries.english: The parcel has left <warehouse>, waiting for the line haul

entries.wording: 【包裹已到达航司仓库，等待起飞】
entries.english: The parcel is at the airline's warehouse, waiting to fly

entries.wording: 到达：【美国 - 纽约】，国际干线运输已从【JFK纽约】启程，航（班）次号：****
entries.english: The international line haul has left <airport>, flight ****
entries.note: The feed masks the flight number.

entries.wording: 到达：【美国 - 纽约】，国际干线运输已从【国际干线运输中转中】启程
entries.english: The international line haul has left <place>

entries.wording: 【包裹已落地国内，等待航司中转】
entries.english: The parcel has landed in China, waiting for the airline's connection

entries.wording: 到达：【中国 - 西安】国际干线运输已到达【XIY西安】
entries.english: The international line haul has reached <airport>

entries.wording: 到达：【西安口岸】包裹准备清关
entries.english: At <port>: the parcel is being prepared for customs clearance

entries.wording: 到达：【西安口岸】包裹清关完成，进入国内运输环节
entries.english: At <port>: customs clearance done, the parcel goes on to domestic transport

entries.wording: 【西安市】陕西西安未央草滩公司 已揽收
entries.english: Picked up by <branch>
entries.note: Yunda's first row after clearance: the courier in China takes the parcel on. The row names the courier with a mobile, which the reader leaves out.

entries.wording: 【运城市】已到达 山西河津市公司
entries.english: Arrived at <station>
entries.note: Yunda's rows end on a hotline in a parenthesis, which the reader leaves out.

entries.wording: 【西安市】已离开 陕西西安分拨交付中心；发往 上海分拨交付中心
entries.english: Left <station> for <station>
Yunda security scan
Yunda security scan at a sorting line

entries.wording: 【上海市】上海青浦区新城公司 正在为您派送
entries.english: Out for delivery from <branch>
entries.note: The row names the courier with a mobile and the branch's landline, which the reader leaves out.

entries.wording: 【代收点】您的快件已暂存至丰巢柜，请及时领取签收
entries.english: Your parcel is in a Hive Box locker, please collect it
entries.note: The row gives the locker's place, the courier's mobile and the branch's numbers, which the reader leaves out.
